72.title: [PLAN-D10]: Outreach Sequencer SKILL.md + 5-touch worker
72.preflightReason:
The original brief was broad. It asked for GHL send, a reply webhook and Sales Desk routing, and it named no exact files. The Architect's repeated comments in the thread narrow it and replace the original DoD. Under the evaluation rules, explicit Architect instructions and earlier proceed confirmations resolve ambiguity.

The narrowed deliverables are concrete:
- `agents/outreach-sequencer/SKILL.md` with 11 sections.
- Five touch templates with placeholders.
- `services/tgl-ops/src/agents/outreach-sequencer/worker.ts` and `sequence.ts`, in dry-run mode.

The cadence is fixed: T1 email day 0, T2 WhatsApp day 2, T3 email with audit PDF day 4, T4 WhatsApp day 7, T5 email day 12.

The outcome is verifiable. The worker must render 5 touches, and `npm run build` and the tests must pass.

Path check: `agents/` and `services/` are writable on a task branch under TASK-P07, and the CI gate covers both. Nothing under `decisions/` or `logs/` may be committed. Tests must use a temp directory or a mocked filesystem.

No SKILL.md §8 Never guardrail is violated. Dry-run mode sends nothing live, and the work involves no production publishing, DNS changes, plugin or script installs, pricing changes or deletions.

Live GHL send, WhatsApp, the reply webhook and Sales Desk routing are out of scope and move to a follow-up issue. The builder must follow the narrowed scope in the comments, not the original DoD checkboxes.
72.lastModelMessage:
I didn't deliver anything on #72. I ran out of my 25-tool-call limit on research and wrote no files. The branch `task/72-plan-d10-outreach-sequencer-sk` is unchanged from `main`, and none of the four definition-of-done boxes is met. I read the files below and nothing else, so everything in this report comes from static reads and no code ran.

I spent the calls reading the SKILL template and the `prospect-researcher` SKILL. I also read `short-form.ts`, `db.ts`, `dedupe.ts`, `app.ts`, `config.ts`, `routes/audit.ts`, `config/agents.yaml` and `package.json`. I should have cut that reading short.

**What I found**
- `agents/_TEMPLATE/SKILL.md` has the 11-section standard. The `prospect-researcher` SKILL is the model for the Outreach Sequencer. It already names the Sequencer as its downstream consumer: prospects with `status: 'reviewed'` and fit score of 70 or more.
- `config/agents.yaml` lists `outreach-sequencer` as `planned`, with a 10:00 IST Mon–Fri `daily_outreach_dispatch` and a $1/day cap.
- `short-form.ts` exposes `runShortFormAudit(lens, {prompts})`. It only accepts exactly 5 prompts and otherwise falls back to The Growth Lab's own coaching prompts. The sequencer therefore has to build 5 prompts per prospect from its category and city.
- GHL is currently used only in `dedupe.ts`: v1 REST, contact lookup by email, `GHL_API_KEY` and `GHL_LOCATION_ID`. There is no GHL send code yet.
- `db.ts` already has a `prospects` table with a `signals` jsonb column and a `handed_to_outreach` status. Sequence state can live in `signals.outreach`, so no migration is needed.
- `app.ts` mounts routers and has no cron starter. `routes/audit.ts` shows the router pattern to copy.

**What I would build with a fresh budget (4 writes plus 1 read)**
1. `agents/outreach-sequencer/SKILL.md`: all 11 template sections, with the `prospect-researcher` and Sales Desk handoffs and a "never send to a prospect with a reply or unsubscribe" rule.
